chapterInfo.content:
1
Ɛfiri Adam so de kɔsi Abraham so
(Gyenesis 5.1-32; 10.1-32; 11.10-26)
1 # Gye 5 Adam, Set, Enos, 2Kenan, Mahalalel, Yared, 3Hanok, Metusela, Lamek, 4Noa, Sem, Ham ne Yafet.
5 # Gye 10.2-5 Yafet mma ne: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Yawan, Tubal, Mesek ne Tiras. 6Gomer mma ne: Askenas, Difat ne Togarma. 7Na Yawan mma ne: Elisa, Tarsis, Kitim ne Rodanim.
8 # Gye 10.6-20 Ham mma ne: Kus, Misraim, Put ne Kanaan. 9Na Kus mma ne: Seba, Hawila, Sabta, Raama ne Sabteka. Na Raama mma ne: Seba ne Dedan. 10Na Kus woo Nimrod, ɔno na ɔfirii aseɛ yɛɛ otumfoɔ asase soɔ. 11Na Misraim woo Ludfoɔ, Anamfoɔ, Lehabfoɔ, Naftuhfoɔ, 12Patrusfoɔ, Kasluhfoɔ a Filistifoɔ firi wɔn mu ne Kaftorfoɔ.
13Na Kanaan woo n’abakan Sidon, Het, 14Yebusini, Amorini, Girgasini, 15Hiwini, Arkini, Sinini, 16Arwadni, Semarini ne Hamatni.
17 # Gye 10.21-31 Sem mma ne: Elam, Asur, Arfaksad, Lud, Aram, Us, Hul, Geter ne Mesek. 18Na Arfaksad woo Sela, na Sela woo Eber. 19Na wɔwoo mma baanu maa Eber, ɔbaako din de Peleg, (na ne berɛ so na asase mu teteeɛ). Na ne nua din de Yoktan. 20Na Yoktan woo Almodad, Selef, Hasarmawet, Yera 21Hadoram, Usal, Dikla, 22Ebal, Abimael, Seba, 23Ofir, Hawila ne Yobab. Yeinom nyinaa ne Yoktan mma.
24 # 1 Be 1.17; Gye 11.10-26 Sem, Arfaksad, Sela, 25Eber, Peleg, Reu, 26Serug, Nahor, Tera, 27Abram, anaa Abraham.
Ismael asefoɔ
(Gyenesis 25.12-16)
28 # Gye 21.3; 16.15 Abraham mma ne: Isak ne Ismael. 29#Gye 25.13-16 Yeinom ne wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ: Ismael abakan Nebaiot; ne Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, 30Misma, Duma, Masa, Hadad, Tema, 31Yetur, Nafis ne Kedema. Yeinom ne Ismael mma. 32#Gye 25.1-3 Na Abraham mpena Ketura mma: Ɔwoo Simran, Yoksan, Medan, Midian, Yisbak ne Sua. Na Yoksan mma ne: Seba ne Dedan. 33Na Midian mma ne: Efa, Efer, Hanok, Abida ne Eldaa. Yeinom nyinaa ne Ketura mma.
Esau asefoɔ
(Gyenesis 36.1-19)
34 # Gye 25.19-26 Na Abraham woo Isak. Na Isak mma ne: Esau ne Israel.
Edomfoɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ne wɔn ahemfo
35 # Gye 36.10-19 Esau mma ne: Elifas, Reuel, Yeus, Yalam ne Kora. 36Elifas mma ne: Teman, Omar, Sefi, Gatam, Kenas, Timna ne Amalek. 37Reuel mma ne: Nahat, Sera, Sama ne Misa.
38 # Gye 36.20-30 Na Seir mma ne: Lotan, Sobal, Sibeon, Ana, Dison, Eser ne Disan. 39Na Lotan mma ne: Hori ne Homam. Na Lotan nuabaa ne Timna. 40Sobal mma ne: Alian, Manahat, Ebal, Sefi ne Onam. Na Sibeon mma ne: Aya ne Ana. 41Ana mma ne: Dison. Na Dison mma ne: Hamran, Esban, Yitran ne Keran. 42Eser mma ne: Bilhan ne Saawan ne Yaakan. Dison mma ne: Us ne Aran.
Edom ahemfo
(Gyenesis 36.31-43)
43 # Gye 36.31-43 Na yeinom ne ahemfo a wɔdii Edom asase soɔ ansa na obi redi Israel mma so hene: Beor ba Bela, na ne kuro din de Dinhaba. 44Bela wui, na Sera ba Yobab a ɔfirii Bosra bɛdii n’adeɛ. 45Yobab wui, na Husam a ɔfiri Teman asase soɔ bɛdii n’adeɛ. 46Husam wui, na Bedad ba Hadad a ɔkum Midian, a ɛwɔ Moab no bɛdii n’adeɛ. Na ne kuro din de Awit. 47Hadad wui na Samla a ɔfiri Masreka bɛdii n’adeɛ. 48Samla wui, na Saulo a ɔfiri Rehobot a ɛda asuo ho bɛdii n’adeɛ. 49Na Saulo wui, na Akbor ba Baal-hanan bɛdii n’adeɛ. 50Baal-hanan wui, na Hadad bɛdii n’adeɛ. Na ne kuro din de Pai, na ne yere din de Mehetabel a ɔyɛ Matred ba Me-sahab babaa. 51Na Hadad wui.
Na Edom atitire nie: Otitire Timna, Otitire Alia, Otitire Yetet, 52Otitire Oholibama, Otitire Ela, Otitire Pinon, 53Otitire Kenas, Otitire Teman, Otitire Mibsar, 54Otitire Magdiel, Otitire Iram. Yeinom ne Edom atitire.

pageProps.chapterText:
Adam, Set, Enos, Kenan, Mahalalel, Yared, Hanok, Metusela, Lamek, Noa, Sem, Ham ne Yafet.
Yafet mma ne: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Yawan, Tubal, Mesek ne Tiras. Gomer mma ne: Askenas, Difat ne Togarma. Na Yawan mma ne: Elisa, Tarsis, Kitim ne Rodanim.
Ham mma ne: Kus, Misraim, Put ne Kanaan. Na Kus mma ne: Seba, Hawila, Sabta, Raama ne Sabteka. Na Raama mma ne: Seba ne Dedan. Na Kus woo Nimrod, ɔno na ɔfirii aseɛ yɛɛ otumfoɔ asase soɔ. Na Misraim woo Ludfoɔ, Anamfoɔ, Lehabfoɔ, Naftuhfoɔ, Patrusfoɔ, Kasluhfoɔ a Filistifoɔ firi wɔn mu ne Kaftorfoɔ.
Na Kanaan woo n’abakan Sidon, Het, Yebusini, Amorini, Girgasini, Hiwini, Arkini, Sinini, Arwadni, Semarini ne Hamatni.
Sem mma ne: Elam, Asur, Arfaksad, Lud, Aram, Us, Hul, Geter ne Mesek. Na Arfaksad woo Sela, na Sela woo Eber. Na wɔwoo mma baanu maa Eber, ɔbaako din de Peleg, (na ne berɛ so na asase mu teteeɛ). Na ne nua din de Yoktan. Na Yoktan woo Almodad, Selef, Hasarmawet, Yera Hadoram, Usal, Dikla, Ebal, Abimael, Seba, Ofir, Hawila ne Yobab. Yeinom nyinaa ne Yoktan mma.
Sem, Arfaksad, Sela, Eber, Peleg, Reu, Serug, Nahor, Tera, Abram, anaa Abraham.


Abraham mma ne: Isak ne Ismael. Yeinom ne wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ: Ismael abakan Nebaiot; ne Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, Misma, Duma, Masa, Hadad, Tema, Yetur, Nafis ne Kedema. Yeinom ne Ismael mma. Na Abraham mpena Ketura mma: Ɔwoo Simran, Yoksan, Medan, Midian, Yisbak ne Sua. Na Yoksan mma ne: Seba ne Dedan. Na Midian mma ne: Efa, Efer, Hanok, Abida ne Eldaa. Yeinom nyinaa ne Ketura mma.


Na Abraham woo Isak. Na Isak mma ne: Esau ne Israel.

Esau mma ne: Elifas, Reuel, Yeus, Yalam ne Kora. Elifas mma ne: Teman, Omar, Sefi, Gatam, Kenas, Timna ne Amalek. Reuel mma ne: Nahat, Sera, Sama ne Misa.
Na Seir mma ne: Lotan, Sobal, Sibeon, Ana, Dison, Eser ne Disan. Na Lotan mma ne: Hori ne Homam. Na Lotan nuabaa ne Timna. Sobal mma ne: Alian, Manahat, Ebal, Sefi ne Onam. Na Sibeon mma ne: Aya ne Ana. Ana mma ne: Dison. Na Dison mma ne: Hamran, Esban, Yitran ne Keran. Eser mma ne: Bilhan ne Saawan ne Yaakan. Dison mma ne: Us ne Aran.


Na yeinom ne ahemfo a wɔdii Edom asase soɔ ansa na obi redi Israel mma so hene: Beor ba Bela, na ne kuro din de Dinhaba. Bela wui, na Sera ba Yobab a ɔfirii Bosra bɛdii n’adeɛ. Yobab wui, na Husam a ɔfiri Teman asase soɔ bɛdii n’adeɛ. Husam wui, na Bedad ba Hadad a ɔkum Midian, a ɛwɔ Moab no bɛdii n’adeɛ. Na ne kuro din de Awit. Hadad wui na Samla a ɔfiri Masreka bɛdii n’adeɛ. Samla wui, na Saulo a ɔfiri Rehobot a ɛda asuo ho bɛdii n’adeɛ. Na Saulo wui, na Akbor ba Baal-hanan bɛdii n’adeɛ. Baal-hanan wui, na Hadad bɛdii n’adeɛ. Na ne kuro din de Pai, na ne yere din de Mehetabel a ɔyɛ Matred ba Me-sahab babaa. Na Hadad wui.
Na Edom atitire nie: Otitire Timna, Otitire Alia, Otitire Yetet, Otitire Oholibama, Otitire Ela, Otitire Pinon, Otitire Kenas, Otitire Teman, Otitire Mibsar, Otitire Magdiel, Otitire Iram. Yeinom ne Edom atitire.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
